Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner turn after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the initial search results. Although the search results from the first WebSurfer turn clearly showed a Fandom wiki page stating "King Arthur... is portrayed by guest star Liam Garrigan," the Planner ignored this explicit confirmation and instead hypothesized that Josh Dallas (Prince Charming) was the actor who pulled the sword. This error in reasoning and source interpretation led to a cycle of incorrect verification attempts and ultimately a wrong solution.
